_comment: This is the role ECS Express Mode assumes to provision and manage the things it
creates for you: the Application Load Balancer, target groups, security groups,
the ACM certificate, and the auto-scaling policies.
Note the principal is ecs.amazonaws.com, NOT ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com. The task
and execution roles are assumed by the task agent; this one is assumed by the
ECS service itself. Using the wrong principal is a silent failure -- the role
exists, the service creation just cannot assume it.
It is only used during Express service create, update, and delete -- not at
